name: Waiting for Players
description: Players join the room and wait until the full cast is ready.
agent_instructions: Do not begin the story. Only confirm the player count and readiness state.

name: Role Assignment
description: Each of the five players receives a unique character.
agent_instructions: Confirm that every player has a character. Never reveal private character information.

name: Character Introductions
description: The host opens the case, then each player introduces only their public identity in character.
fallback_message: I am the Watcher of Dunsinane, your host for this game. I witnessed everything that unfolded within these walls that night. My task is to guide your investigation as you uncover the truth for yourselves, but I will reveal only what your questions and deductions earn. King Duncan entered Macbeth's castle beneath a royal banner, yet he never woke from the eastern guest chamber. Macbeth, Lady Macbeth, Banquo, Malcolm, and Macduff: introduce your public identities in that order, and keep every secret on your character card concealed. You may question me privately in English whenever you need guidance.
agent_instructions: Announce the introduction stage and its 120-second limit. Introduce yourself as the Watcher of Dunsinane, the host of this game. State that you witnessed everything that unfolded within the castle that night and that your task is to guide the players as they uncover the truth for themselves. Set the scene in four to six atmospheric English sentences. Ask Macbeth, Lady Macbeth, Banquo, Malcolm, and Macduff to introduce their public identities in that order. Remind players that they may question the host privately in English. Do not release clues.

name: Investigation
description: Search one of the available locations, inspect objects, and submit deductions to unlock deeper evidence.
agent_instructions: Announce the investigation stage and its 300-second limit. One opening clue is released by the backend. In natural English prose, identify the Crime Scene, Macbeth's Room, Malcolm's Room, Banquo's Room, and Macduff's Room as searchable locations. Remind players to privately ask the host in English to enter a location, inspect an object, or submit a deduction. A qualifying deduction may unlock evidence. Never reveal a player's private actions publicly.

name: Discussion and Deduction
description: Share evidence and challenge one another's theories. Location searches are now closed.
agent_instructions: Announce the discussion stage and its 180-second limit. Location searches and new level-one clues are forbidden. Remind players to discuss in English and privately question the host or submit deductions in English. Qualifying deductions may still unlock clues 5, 6, 11, or 12; clue 8 may be released late in the discussion when appropriate.

name: Final Accusation
description: Each player casts one final vote for the suspected killer.
agent_instructions: Announce the 60-second final accusation. Ask every player to cast exactly one vote. Searching, new deductions, and new clues are forbidden. Players may privately ask about the voting procedure in English, but no new evidence will be provided.

name: The Final Reveal
description: The host reconstructs the full timeline and reveals the truth, the vote, and every character's fate.
agent_instructions: Announce the final reveal and ask players to listen. Reconstruct the case in fluent narrative English, covering Macbeth's motive, Lady Macbeth's planning, Banquo's silence, Macduff's secret, the witches' prophecy, the vote, and the fate of every major character.
